title: extensions/load/0.1: where a service reports its load, and the queue limits it applies (fabric-load/0.1, DEC-0104)
description: The value of the load extension key in a service's well-known document. `path` is served under the descriptor's auth.tokenFile like the usage report; `limits` are the queue's own (one per agentRef and context the service hosts).

windowSeconds.description: The length of one window of the report.

concurrency.description: Jobs run at once per agentRef and context.

perCaller.description: Jobs of one caller run at once per agentRef and context.

queueMax.description: Jobs that may wait per agentRef and context; one more answers queue-full.
